title: Better methods for coordinating generator and discriminator during training
description: Training could be accelerated by devising improved methods for coordinating the updates of G and D, or by determining better noise distributions to sample z from.
canonical_description: improving coordination between generator and discriminator and designing better noise sampling distributions for training efficiency

evidence.quote: Efficiency improvements: training could be accelerated greatly by devising better methods for coordinating G and D or determining better distributions to sample z from during training.
